name: @projexlight/sdk-identity
summary: Six-layer identity at hyperscale for ProjexCloud: canonical Master Person + alias graph + envelope-encrypted credentials, OIDC discovery + JWKS, password/MFA login, SAML 2.0 ServiceProvider, SCIM 2.0 user provisioning, social IdP (Google/Apple/Microsoft) callbacks, and customer-consented support impersonation. Mints six-layer JWTs that downstream SDKs key authorization off.

endpoints.description: Create an identity.person + email alias + password credential; returns a six-layer JWT.
Self-serve signup: person + org + default app + trial tenant + admin membership in one transaction. Returns a JWT scoped to the new tenant.
Verify email+password, mint six-layer JWT. Optional tenant_id selects the calling tenant context from the person's memberships.
JWKS public-key set for JWT verification; public.
OIDC userinfo endpoint; bearer-authed; returns the claim set of the calling JWT.
Issue an MFA challenge (TOTP / SMS / WebAuthn / passkey) for the calling persona.
Verify a presented MFA factor; on success mints a JWT with the factor in the AMR claim.
Merge an additional alias (phone, social subject, SAML NameID) into the calling person's MDM graph.
Support persona requests temporary access to a tenant; emits impersonation_grant in 'pending'.
Manager + tenant approve the grant; mints a short-lived impersonation JWT bearing the support_impersonator actor kind.
Voluntary or expiry-driven termination of an impersonation session.
SAML 2.0 SP metadata document for tenant-specific IdP integration.
SAML 2.0 Assertion Consumer Service; consumes IdP response, JIT-provisions the person + memberships.
SCIM 2.0 user provisioning from upstream IdP (Okta, Azure AD, OneLogin).
SCIM 2.0 user deprovisioning; soft-suspends the person and revokes active sessions.
Social IdP OAuth callback (Google / Apple / Microsoft). JIT-creates or merges the alias graph.

events.name: identity.person.registered.v1
events.description: New Master Person created; carries home_region.

events.name: identity.session.created.v1
events.description: Successful login or token mint; carries amr, mfa_satisfied, tenant_id.

events.name: identity.mfa.verified.v1
events.description: MFA factor verified; carries the factor kind.

events.name: identity.impersonation.approved.v1
events.description: Manager + tenant approved the impersonation grant.

events.name: identity.federation.config.upserted.v1
events.description: SAML / SCIM / social IdP config registered or updated for a tenant.

events.name: identity.scim.user.provisioned.v1
events.description: SCIM upstream provisioned a user; carries external_id mapping.

models.description: Canonical Master Person (L1) per P2 §5. Per-tenant key tier wraps everything below.
MDM alias graph: email / phone / gov-id / biometric / social_idp_subject / saml_nameid → person_id.
Passwords + MFA secrets, vaulted via envelope encryption (sdk-vault).
L2 — per (person, app) materialization on first login.
L3 — person + tenant + bu + role_template_id; sourced for JWT claims.
Per-tenant SAML / SCIM / social IdP config; jit_enabled flag.
Active sessions; also held in Redis for hot lookup.

hooks.name: buildSixLayerClaims
hooks.description: Helper that assembles a SixLayerJwtClaims object from a (person, tenant, app) tuple; used by login + signup + SAML/SCIM JIT paths.

hooks.name: verifyJwt
hooks.description: Verifies + decodes a JWT minted by this SDK. Throws on expired/invalid.

hooks.name: requireAuth
hooks.description: Fastify preHandler middleware that attaches the verified six-layer claims to req.auth or 401s.

scenarios.title: Register a person with email + password, return a JWT
scenarios.when_to_use: Self-serve signup flow where a new human is creating an account but joining an existing tenant later (via invite).
scenarios.expected_outcome: Returns a JWT whose sub is the new person_id and tenant_id is null. Emits identity.person.registered.v1 to the audit chain.

scenarios.title: Self-serve full-tenant signup in one transaction
scenarios.when_to_use: When a new customer is starting a workspace from scratch — person + org + default app + trial tenant + admin membership all in one DB transaction.
scenarios.example_code:
import { signupTenant } from '@projexlight/sdk-identity';
const { person_id, tenant_id, app_id } = await signupTenant({ email, password, company_name, region: 'us-east-1' });
scenarios.expected_outcome: Atomic: either all six rows land or none do. New tenant.status is 'trial'. Returned JWT carries tenant_id + app_id so downstream SDKs route correctly without re-login.

scenarios.title: Login + MFA challenge + verify
scenarios.when_to_use: Production sign-in flow where the calling persona requires MFA before being granted a full-permission JWT.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Final JWT has mfa_satisfied=true and the AMR claim lists the factor used. Emits identity.mfa.verified.v1 to the audit chain.

scenarios.title: SAML 2.0 ServiceProvider handshake with JIT user provisioning
scenarios.when_to_use: Enterprise customers federating via Okta / Azure AD / OneLogin. ProjexCloud is the SP; their IdP redirects to /saml/:tenant_id/acs.
scenarios.expected_outcome: First-time login JIT-creates an identity.person with a saml_nameid alias and an identity.tenant_membership for the asserted role. Repeat logins reuse the existing person. Emits identity.session.created.v1.

scenarios.title: Support persona impersonates a tenant with manager + customer approval
scenarios.when_to_use: L3 / L4 support engineer needs to reproduce a customer bug in their tenant. Hard requirement: customer-side consent + manager-side approval, both recorded.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Granted JWT carries actor.kind='support_impersonator' and impersonator_user_id; expires in 1 hour by default. Every request made under this JWT is tagged in the audit chain so the customer can review post-incident.

compliance_posture.notes: Bcrypt rounds default to 10 (OWASP minimum). Credentials envelope-encrypted via sdk-vault. SAML signing cert must be FIPS-140-2 for FedRAMP. SCIM provisioning honors the federation_config.jit_enabled flag — disable for strict provisioned-only tenants.

pricing_skus.unit_description: per successful login (includes MFA verify if applicable)
per MFA challenge issued (SMS factor has provider passthrough cost)
